integrity: The projection, distance-shell, farthest-point and Gaussian statements are one unified theorem and use an explicit mathematical proof. No independent validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Standard unweighted Euclidean realization only; rank at least three, head size at least the rank and tail size at least two.
The metric limit assumes nondegenerate proportional parameter growth; other regimes and continuous-volume distance distributions are not claimed.
Finite exact and numerical examples do not prove the all-parameter or asymptotic claims.
Historical priority has not received independent bibliographic audit.
title: Exact Euclidean deep-hole shells and a hypergeometric limit for panhandle matroid polytopes
